timeCompression.why: Both Wait nodes are parameterless Wait v1.1, which waits its default of 5 seconds (n8n 2.47.7 Wait node: the 1-hour default, amount 1 in hours, applies to v1 only; v1.1 defaults to amount 5 in seconds, and the runtime's defaults agree). Shortened to 1 second on both sides to keep the bench's wall time down across the job polls. This changes when the run resumes, not what it does: the mock's poll replies do not depend on elapsed time and no expression in the template reads $now. It is not a placeholder fill, so results flag it as time compression (config.nonPlaceholder).
